title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
abstract: arXiv:2610.38006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.

translated_title: 医疗保健专业人员视角下的算法偏见
translated_abstract: 本文聚焦于医疗保健信息系统中机器学习与人工智能应用中的算法偏见问题。基于对具有不同工作角色（如临床与行政岗位）的医疗保健专业人员开展的问卷调查和访谈所获得的定量数据与定性评论，本研究提供了关于算法偏见、感知公平性以及对机器学习算法和算法生成结果的预期接受度与采纳意愿之间关系的发现。研究结果表明，医疗保健专业人员对算法偏见的成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性以及偏见缓解方法的看法可能因其工作角色、视角、任务和算法特征的不同而有所差异。要确保医疗保健领域的公平与平等，还需要更多研究来探究算法偏见问题。
tldr: 本研究通过对不同岗位医疗保健专业人员的问卷调查与访谈发现，他们对算法偏见的成因、评估标准、公平感知及偏见缓解方法的观点会因其工作角色、视角、任务和算法特征的不同而有所差异。
en_tdlr: Through surveys and interviews with healthcare professionals in different job roles, this study finds that their opinions on the causes of algorithmic bias, algorithm assessment criteria, perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and algorithm characteristics.
